title: Weird hardware restrictions
body: This app renders a simple 3D model of the Earth in ugly low resolution; the settings restrict you from setting a higher quality unless you upgrade to a nearly brand new device. Did the devs use Google Earth 10 years ago?

title: Incredible integration!
body: I saw this on editors choice and thought I’d give it a try. I’m incredibly impressed. As an amateur developer, I need to learn from them. The app is primarily an organization tool from flights, but helps to create a “story” of your flight by organizing images and timeframes that you can review later. But where it REALLY shines for me is how they managed to search photos and other things on your iPhone and intelligently line all of them up retroactively. I was able to bring three flights and all the pictures from the trip together from a year ago. It’s Ai integration easily allowed my Chat to find other flights and send the info off to a private link Raylie created, which then imported everything and synced it up in Raylie. Not to mention the app is beautiful, simple , and easy to use. This app is a joy to use.

title: Pretty cool!
body: Beautiful app, great integration with Flighty. One of the coolest options available on App Stote for frequent travelers, congrats!
